scope: Historical Amazon operating-income guidance versus actuals; operating income is distinct from non-operating Anthropic fair-value gains and from the frozen GAAP diluted-EPS outcome.

comparisons.notes: Release says guide included about $1B higher year-over-year Amazon Leo costs and investment in quick commerce / lower prices internationally; assumes no additional acquisitions, restructurings or legal settlements.

Guide assumed Prime Day in Q2 and no additional acquisitions, restructurings or legal settlements. Actual is from prior Q2 source capsule / SEC companyfacts; Q2 Anthropic investment gains are non-operating and do not explain operating-income excess.

Reported actual was within guidance. Q3 release subsequently disclosed $2.5B FTC settlement charge and $1.8B estimated severance; without those, operating income would have been $21.7B, $1.2B above guide ceiling. It also reported $9.5B Anthropic pre-tax investment gain in non-operating income, separate from OI.

interpretation_limits: Two sequential 2026 actual quarters exceeded the preceding top-of-range OI guidance, while one 2025 comparison landed inside the range before special-charge adjustment; this is a tiny, nonstationary sample, not a calibrated forecast-error distribution.
Do not treat current Q3 2026 OI guidance $22.5–26.5B as a realized ceiling or assume past overages repeat.
Operating income comparisons say nothing direct about Q3 GAAP EPS because Anthropic/OpenAI marks, taxes, diluted shares and other non-operating items can dominate EPS.
